name: Unichem Laboratories Ltd
about: Unichem Laboratories Ltd is involved in pharmaceuticals in Generics, APIs and Contract Manufacturing (CMO) areas.[1]
keyPoints: Therapeutic Areas The company manufactures and markets APIs and pharmaceutical formulations as branded & non-branded generics. The company’s products cater to diverse therapeutic areas such as cardiology, gas, diabetology, gastroenterology psychiatry, neurology, antibacterial, anti-infective, and pain management. [1]
pros: Stock is trading at 1.19 times its book value
Company has delivered good profit growth of 25.0% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 2.34% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.305 Cr.
